16	
17	| 论文 | 威胁点 | 为何不构成直接威胁 |
18	|------|--------|-------------------|

22

25	## 2. 新发现的相关论文

27	### 2.1 High Priority — 建议新增引用
28	
29	#### (1) Subramanyam, Chen & Grossman 2025
30	- **Title:** Scaling Laws Revisited: Modeling the Role of Data Quality in Language Model Pretraining
31	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (under review, ICLR 2026 OpenReview)
32	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03313
33	- **Category:** theoretical-foundation
34	- **关系:** 用 effective-sample-size 和信息论视角建模数据质量参数 Q，提出 quality-aware scaling law。与我们的 α_eff(b) 共享 ESS 理论动机。
35	- **引用建议:** ✅ 必须引用。在 Related Work 中作为 "ESS-based data quality formalization" 引用，强调我们是 instance-level adaptive 而他们是 corpus-level static。
36	- **Differentiation:** 他们的 Q 是 corpus-level 静态参数（用于预测 loss），我们的 α_eff(b) 是 per-batch 动态量（用于选 b*）；他们不涉及检测器或加权公式。
37	
38	#### (2) Amin et al. 2025
39	- **Title:** Escaping Collapse: The Strength of Weak Data for Large Language Model Training
40	- **Venue:** NeurIPS 2025
41	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08924
42	- **Category:** theoretical-foundation
43	- **关系:** Boosting-inspired 理论证明 nearly minimal curation 即可避免 collapse。为我们的 "lightweight detector sufficiency" claim 提供理论支撑。
44	- **引用建议:** ✅ 强烈建议引用。支撑我们的 Claim "even weak detectors (TF-IDF+LR) suffice"。
45	
46	#### (3) Kang et al. 2025
47	- **Title:** Demystifying Synthetic Data in LLM Pre-training: A Systematic Study of Scaling Laws, Benefits, and Pitfalls
48	- **Venue:** EMNLP 2025
49	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01631
50	- **Category:** background
51	- **关系:** 1000+ LLM 实验揭示合成数据 mixing 最佳比例 ~30%，rephrased 数据不导致 collapse 但 textbook-style 会。为我们的 contamination setting 提供 empirical context。
52	- **引用建议:** ✅ 建议引用。在 Introduction 中说明 synthetic data 在 pretraining 中的规模和风险。
53	
54	#### (4) Kazdan et al. 2025
55	- **Title:** Collapse or Thrive: Perils and Promises of Synthetic Data in a Self-Generating World
56	- **Venue:** ICML 2025
57	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.16713
58	- **Category:** background
59	- **关系:** 系统分析 replace/accumulate/fixed-size 三种 workflow 下 synthetic data 的影响。我们的场景是 "unknown contamination in accumulated web data"。
60	- **引用建议:** ✅ 建议引用。Background section 引述不同 data workflow 设置。
61	
62	#### (5) Martino et al. 2025/2026
63	- **Title:** Effective Sample Size Approximations as Entropy Measures
64	- **Venue:** Computational Statistics, Vol. 40, 2025 (arXiv: 2602.22954)
65	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22954
66	- **Category:** theoretical-foundation
67	- **关系:** 分析 ESS 与 Rényi/Tsallis 熵族的关系，提出多种 ESS 度量。直接服务于我们的 ESS stability constraint 理论基础。
68	- **引用建议:** ✅ 建议引用。在 Method section 讨论 ESS 约束时引用，强化 ESS 理论的严谨性。
69	
70	#### (6) Grangier, Fan, Seto & Ablin 2025 (CRISP)
71	- **Title:** Task-Adaptive Pretrained Language Models via Clustered-Importance Sampling
72	- **Venue:** ICLR 2025
73	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.03735
74	- **Category:** method-component
75	- **关系:** Clustered IS for pretraining distribution matching。与 Drayson 的 SIR 和 Xie 的 DSIR 在方法论上相关——同属 importance sampling 用于 pretraining。
76	- **引用建议:** ✅ 建议引用。Related Work 的 importance sampling for pretraining 段落。

80	#### (7) ToReMi (Zhu et al. 2025)
81	- **Title:** ToReMi: Topic-Aware Data Reweighting for Dynamic Pre-Training Data Selection
82	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (2504.00695)
83	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.00695
84	- **Category:** method-component
85	- **关系:** Topic-level 动态重加权（两阶段：先 loss-based 后 topic-aware），与我们的 instance-level provenance-based 互补。
86	- **引用建议:** 可选。如需展示 "dynamic reweighting" 是活跃方向可引。
87	- **Differentiation:** Topic-level granularity, loss-driven（不用检测器），无 ESS 约束。
88	
89	#### (8) QuaDMix (ByteDance, 2025)
90	- **Title:** QuaDMix: Quality-Diversity Balanced Data Selection for Efficient LLM Pretraining
91	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (2504.16511)
92	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16511
93	- **Category:** method-component
94	- **关系:** 多质量标准 + diversity 的统一选择框架，用 proxy model + LightGBM 回归预测性能。
95	- **引用建议:** 可选。如需 broader data selection 对比。
96	
97	#### (9) LiLAW (Morales et al. 2025)
98	- **Title:** LiLAW: Lightweight Learnable Adaptive Weighting to Meta-Learn Sample Difficulty
99	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (2509.20786, updated 2026.03)
100	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20786
101	- **Category:** method-component
102	- **关系:** 3 可学习参数做 sample-adaptive weighting，应用于 synthetic data 和 noisy training。
103	- **引用建议:** 可选。如需讨论 "adaptive weighting without detection" 替代方案。
104	- **Differentiation:** Meta-learning（需验证集），不基于 provenance/detection，不同理论动机。
105	
106	#### (10) Schaeffer et al. 2025
107	- **Title:** Position: Model Collapse Does Not Mean What You Think
108	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (2503.03150)
109	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.03150
110	- **Category:** background
111	- **关系:** 指出 model collapse 有 8 种定义，某些 collapse 场景在现实条件下可避免。
112	- **引用建议:** 可选。如在 Discussion 中讨论 collapse 定义的 nuance。

115	- **Title:** Beyond Surface-Level Similarity: Hierarchical Contamination Detection for Synthetic Training Data in Foundation Models
116	- **Venue:** arXiv preprint (2511.17602)
117	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17602
118	- **Category:** background
119	- **关系:** 4层级 contamination detection（token/semantic/reasoning/performance cliff）。与我们的检测器组件相关。
120	- **引用建议:** 可选。如讨论检测器泛化性问题。
121	
122	#### (12) Gerstgrasser et al. 2024
123	- **Title:** Is Model Collapse Inevitable? Breaking the Curse of Recursion by Accumulating Real and Synthetic Data
124	- **Venue:** ICML 2024
125	- **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01413
126	- **Category:** background
127	- **关系:** 证明 data accumulation 避免 collapse（test error 有限上界）。我们的场景是 web data 自然积累。
128	- **引用建议:** 可选。Background section 引用。

**Paper Title:** Scaling Laws Revisited: Modeling the Role of Data Quality in Language Model Pretraining

**Authors:** Anirudh Subramanyam, Yuxin Chen, and Robert L. Grossman from the University of Chicago

**Key Contributions:**

The paper introduces a dimensionless data-quality parameter Q and proposes a quality-aware scaling law extending the Chinchilla framework to predict loss as a joint function of model size, data volume, and data quality.

The law is motivated by an effective-sample-size and information-theoretic view of noisy or redundant corpora, and it admits two practical estimators for Q: (i) a corruption rate proxy and (ii) a deficiency measure.

**Submission Date:** September 30, 2025

The paper addresses a gap in existing research by formalizing data quality within a principled scaling law framework, something that prior work had not done despite exploring architecture variants and data treatments such as dataset filtering and noise injection in language model pretraining.

I found the paper! Here are the key details about arXiv paper 2410.16713:

**Title:** "Collapse or Thrive? Perils and Promises of Synthetic Data in a Self-Generating World"

**Authors:** Joshua Kazdan, Rylan Schaeffer, Apratim Dey, Matthias Gerstgrasser, Rafael Rafailov, David L. Donoho, and Sanmi Koyejo

**Main Topic:** The paper addresses what happens when generative machine learning models are pretrained on web-scale datasets containing data generated by earlier models.

**Key Research Questions and Findings:**

Some prior work warns of "model collapse" as the web is overwhelmed by synthetic data; other work suggests the problem can be contained by managing how available data are used in pretraining.

The paper studies three training-workflows across three generative model task-settings (multivariate Gaussian estimation, kernel density estimation, and language-model fine-tuning), confirming that replacing all real data with successive generations of purely synthetic data causes model collapse in all task-settings studied.

A key finding is that a non-trivial interaction between real and synthetic data is found, where the value of synthetic data for reducing test loss depends on the absolute quantity of real data.

The paper was submitted on October 22, 2024, with subsequent updated versions released in December 2024, February 2025, and March 2025.

## Title
Task-Adaptive Pretrained Language Models via Clustered-Importance Sampling

## Authors and Details
The paper is by David Grangier, Simin Fan, Skyler Seto, and Pierre Ablin, submitted on September 30, 2024, and was presented at the International Conference on Learning Representation (ICLR), 2025.

## Main Contribution
The paper proposes a novel method called ClusteRed Importance SamPling (CRISP), which clusters the generalist dataset and samples from these clusters based on their frequencies in the smaller specialist dataset.

## Problem Addressed
Specialist language models focus on a specific task or domain on which they often outperform generalist LMs of the same size. However, the specialist data needed to pretrain these models is only available in limited amount for most tasks. In this work, the authors build specialist models from large generalist training sets instead.

## Key Features
The method is scalable, suitable for both pretraining and continued pretraining, and works well in multi-task settings. CRISP performs favorably compared to other methods that adjust the training distribution of the generalist data with guidance from the limited domain-specific data.

I found the paper you're looking for! Here's information about arxiv 2510.01631:

## Demystifying Synthetic Data in LLM Pre-training: A Systematic Study of Scaling Laws, Benefits, and Pitfalls

**Authors:** Feiyang Kang, Newsha Ardalani, Michael Kuchnik, Youssef Emad, Mostafa Elhoushi, Shubhabrata Sengupta, Shang-Wen Li, Ramya Raghavendra, Ruoxi Jia, and Carole-Jean Wu

**Overview:**
The paper addresses how training data plays a crucial role in Large Language Models (LLM) scaling, yet high quality data is of limited supply, and synthetic data techniques offer a potential path toward sidestepping these limitations.

**Methodology:**
The researchers conducted a large-scale empirical investigation (>1000 LLMs with >100k GPU hours) using a unified protocol and scaling laws, comparing natural web data, diverse synthetic types (rephrased text, generated textbooks), and mixtures of natural and synthetic data.

**Key Findings:**
- Pre-training on rephrased synthetic data alone is not faster than pre-training on natural web texts; while pre-training on 1/3 rephrased synthetic data mixed with 2/3 natural web texts can speed up 5-10x (to reach the same validation loss) at larger data budgets.
- Pre-training on textbook-style synthetic data alone results in notably higher loss on many downstream domains especially at small data budgets.

The paper was submitted to arXiv on October 2, 2025.

I found the paper you're looking for! Here's what I found:

**Paper Details:**

The paper is titled "Escaping Collapse: The Strength of Weak Data for Large Language Model Training" by Kareem Amin and 5 other authors. The authors are from Google Research and University of Southern California, including Kareem Amin, Sara Babakniya, Alex Bie, Weiwei Kong, Umar Syed, and Sergei Vassilvitskii.

**Main Topic:**

The paper addresses how synthetically-generated data plays an increasingly larger role in training large language models, but without proper curation it can cause LLM performance to plateau or "collapse" after many training iterations.

**Research Approach:**

The authors formalize this question and develop a theoretical framework to investigate how much curation is needed to ensure LLM performance continually improves, with analysis inspired by boosting, a classic machine learning technique that leverages a very weak learning algorithm to produce an arbitrarily good classifier.

**Key Finding:**

The key finding is that by injecting information through an external synthetic data verifier, whether a human or a better model, synthetic retraining will not cause model collapse.

The paper was submitted on February 13, 2025, and the current version was last revised on November 29, 2025. You can access it directly at https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08924.

## Paper Information

**Title:** "Effective sample size approximations as entropy measures"

**Authors:** L. Martino, V. Elvira

**arXiv ID:** 2602.22954 (math)

**Submission Date:** February 26, 2026

## Summary

This work analyzes alternative effective sample size (ESS) metrics for importance sampling algorithms and discusses a possible extended range of applications. The authors show the relationship between the ESS expressions used in the literature and two entropy families, the Rényi and Tsallis entropy.

The Rényi entropy is connected to the Huggins-Roy's ESS family, and the authors prove that all the ESS functions included in the Huggins-Roy's family fulfill all the desirable theoretical conditions.

The paper also analyzes connections with several other fields, such as the Hill numbers introduced in ecology, the Gini inequality coefficient employed in economics, and the Gini impurity index used mainly in machine learning.

The paper is available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22954

## Demystifying Synthetic Data in LLM Pre-training: A Systematic Study of Scaling Laws, Benefits, and Pitfalls

The paper is by Feiyang Kang, Newsha Ardalani, Michael Kuchnik, Youssef Emad, Mostafa Elhoushi, Shubhabrata Sengupta, Shang-Wen Li, Ramya Raghavendra, Ruoxi Jia, and Carole-Jean Wu, and was accepted to EMNLP 2025. It appears in the Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pages 10739–10758, Suzhou, China.

### Key Findings:

The work conducts a large-scale empirical investigation (>1000 LLMs with >100k GPU hours) using a unified protocol and scaling laws, comparing natural web data, diverse synthetic types (rephrased text, generated textbooks), and mixtures of natural and synthetic data.

Major results include:

- Pre-training on rephrased synthetic data alone is not faster than pre-training on natural web texts; while pre-training on 1/3 rephrased synthetic data mixed with 2/3 natural web texts can speed up 5-10x

- Optimal ratios of synthetic data in training data mixtures empirically converge to ~30% for rephrased synthetic data

- Larger generator models do not necessarily yield better pre-training data than ~8B-param models

- Training on rephrased synthetic data shows no degradation in performance in foreseeable scales whereas training on mixtures of textbook-style pure-generated synthetic data shows patterns predicted by "model collapse"

# 研究方向：基于收敛理论的自适应污染重加权

# ============================================================
# Category: direct-competitor
# 同主题/同方法的论文
# ============================================================

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: he_2025_golden_ratio
  title: "Golden Ratio Weighting Prevents Model Collapse"
  authors: "Hengzhi He, Shirong Xu, Guang Cheng"
  venue: "Under review at JRSSB, 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.18049"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18049"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "从理论推导合成/真实数据混合的最优权重，发现最优权重为黄金比例的倒数(~0.62)"
  key_findings: "在高斯估计、GLM、非参数估计等场景下，当合成数据与真实数据等量时，真实数据的最优权重约为 0.62（黄金比例倒数）。公式 w*=(√(k²+4k)−k)/2, k=真实/合成样本比"
  differentiation:

  relevance_to_us: "同样是理论推导最优权重，但针对 real/synthetic 固定混合比例，未考虑检测器置信度的连续估计"

  title: "Beyond Model Collapse: Scaling Up with Synthesized Data Requires Verification"
  authors: "Yunzhen Feng, Elvis Dohmatob, Pu Yang, François Charton, Julia Kempe"
  venue: "ICLR 2025"
  year: 2025
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07515"
  category: direct-competitor

  key_findings: "用高斯混合模型和线性分类器推导条件，证明 verifier 引导的合成数据筛选可避免 model collapse；即使 verifier 不完美也能受益"
  relevance_to_us: "与我们的方法最相似——都用检测器置信度来处理合成数据。区别在于他们做 hard filtering，我们做 soft reweighting"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

# Literature Map for provenance_weight_training
# 研究方向：基于收敛理论的自适应污染重加权
# 核心公式：w=(1-q)^b，q 为检测器合成概率，b* 为理论最优权重指数
# 更新日期：2026-05-15（文献扫描：补充 Wang et al. + 4 方向新文献 + 修正 2 处错误）

# ============================================================
# Category: direct-competitor
# 同主题/同方法的论文
# ============================================================

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: he_2025_golden_ratio
  title: "Golden Ratio Weighting Prevents Model Collapse"
  authors: "Hengzhi He, Shirong Xu, Guang Cheng"
  venue: "Under review at JRSSB, 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.18049"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18049"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "从理论推导合成/真实数据混合的最优权重，发现最优权重为黄金比例的倒数(~0.62)"
  key_findings: "在高斯估计、GLM、非参数估计等场景下，当合成数据与真实数据等量时，真实数据的最优权重约为 0.62（黄金比例倒数）。公式 w*=(√(k²+4k)−k)/2, k=真实/合成样本比"
  differentiation:
    scope: "纯理论工作，假设已知污染比例，未涉及检测器或 LLM 实验，不处理 unknown/online 设置"
  relevance_to_us: "同样是理论推导最优权重，但针对 real/synthetic 固定混合比例，未考虑检测器置信度的连续估计"

- id: feng_2025_beyond_collapse
  title: "Beyond Model Collapse: Scaling Up with Synthesized Data Requires Verification"
  authors: "Yunzhen Feng, Elvis Dohmatob, Pu Yang, François Charton, Julia Kempe"
  venue: "ICLR 2025"
  year: 2025
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07515"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用 verifier 过滤合成数据防止 model collapse，理论证明即使不完美的 verifier 也有效"
  key_findings: "用高斯混合模型和线性分类器推导条件，证明 verifier 引导的合成数据筛选可避免 model collapse；即使 verifier 不完美也能受益"
  relevance_to_us: "与我们的方法最相似——都用检测器置信度来处理合成数据。区别在于他们做 hard filtering，我们做 soft reweighting"

# ============================================================
# Category: theoretical-foundation
# 理论动机来源
# ============================================================

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

# ============================================================
# Category: method-component
# 我们用到的技术组件
# ============================================================

- id: kimura_2024_iw_survey
  title: "A Short Survey on Importance Weighting for Machine Learning"
  authors: "Masanari Kimura, Hideitsu Hino"
  venue: "TMLR 2024"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.10175"
  category: method-component
  role: "importance weighting 在机器学习中的全面综述，覆盖分布偏移、密度比估计等核心理论"
  key_findings: "系统整理了 importance weighting 在监督学习分布偏移下的理论保证和应用，包括 covariate shift、domain adaptation 等场景"
  relevance_to_us: "为我们的 importance weighting 框架提供理论基础和方法论参考"

- id: vehtari_2024_psis
  title: "Pareto Smoothed Importance Sampling"
  authors: "Aki Vehtari, Daniel Simpson, Andrew Gelman, Yuling Yao, Jonah Gabry"
  venue: "JMLR 2024"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.02646"
  category: method-component
  role: "提供稳定的 effective sample size 估计和收敛诊断方法"

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: he_2025_golden_ratio
  title: "Golden Ratio Weighting Prevents Model Collapse"
  authors: "Hengzhi He, Shirong Xu, Guang Cheng"
  venue: "Under review at JRSSB, 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.18049"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18049"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "从理论推导合成/真实数据混合的最优权重，发现最优权重为黄金比例的倒数(~0.62)"
  key_findings: "在高斯估计、GLM、非参数估计等场景下，当合成数据与真实数据等量时，真实数据的最优权重约为 0.62（黄金比例倒数）。公式 w*=(√(k²+4k)−k)/2, k=真实/合成样本比"
  differentiation:
    scope: "纯理论工作，假设已知污染比例，未涉及检测器或 LLM 实验，不处理 unknown/online 设置"
  relevance_to_us: "同样是理论推导最优权重，但针对 real/synthetic 固定混合比例，未考虑检测器置信度的连续估计"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

# Literature Map for provenance_weight_training
# 研究方向：基于收敛理论的自适应污染重加权
# 核心公式：w=(1-q)^b，q 为检测器合成概率，b* 为理论最优权重指数
# 更新日期：2026-05-16（文献验证：新增 6 篇 high-priority 论文，全部经 arXiv/venue 交叉验证）

- id: drayson_2025_detection_collapse
  title: "Machine-Generated Text Detection Prevents Language Model Collapse"
  authors: "George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz, Vasileios Lampos"
  venue: "EMNLP 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.15654"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15654"
  github: "https://github.com/GeorgeDrayson/model_collapse"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用同一公式 w=(1-q)^b 进行重加权，但 b 为验证集 empirical 选取，训练中固定"
  method_summary: >
    Detect-and-reweight 防止递归训练 model collapse。检测器为 ModernBERT 150M
    (MAGE fine-tune, in-domain AUC=0.986, OOD AUC=0.943)。权重公式 wⱼ=(1-q(xⱼ))^b / Σₗ(1-q(xₗ))^b，
    通过 SIR 按权重重采样训练数据。b 通过 WikiText-2 验证集上 1 代递归训练后评估选取
    (GPT-2/SmolLM 135M/360M 用 b=10, SmolLM 1.7B 用 b=1)，训练全程固定。
    实验覆盖 4 个模型 (GPT-2 124M, SmolLM 135M/360M/1.7B)、10 代递归训练、6 种解码策略。
    结果 PPL 降低 0.85%–25.65%，diversity 提升 3.44%–14.62%。
  key_findings: "验证 detect-and-reweight 有效防止 model collapse 且优于纯人类数据训练；b 值对模型规模敏感（小模型 b=10，大模型 b=1）"
  differentiation:
    b_selection: "Drayson: 验证集 empirical grid search, per-model 固定 | 我们: α_eff(b) + ESS 约束, per-batch 自适应"
    contamination_setting: "Drayson: 不假设已知比例（原文明确声明），但实验为控制设置 | 我们: 未知比例（batch 统计量在线估计）"
    detector: "Drayson: ModernBERT 150M (AUC=0.986) | 我们: TF-IDF+LR (AUC=0.939)，证明轻量检测器即可"
    theory: "Drayson: 无 b 选取理论（SIR 启发式） | 我们: 收敛理论 motivated α_eff(b) 推导"
    training_scenario: "Drayson: 递归训练 model collapse prevention | 我们: Web corpus 一次性预训练中的未知污染"
    scale: "Drayson: WikiText-2 (~2M tokens) | 我们: FineWeb subset (132M+ tokens)"
    dynamics: "Drayson: b 固定（训练全程不变） | 我们: b* per-batch 自适应"
  our_advantages:
    - "From heuristic to principled: 理论推导 b* 替代 empirical grid search，零额外 validation cost"
    - "Zero validation cost: 无需 validation set 做 b 选择，适用大规模 web pretraining（Drayson 也不假设已知比例，但其 b 选择依赖 validation set）"
    - "Lightweight detector sufficiency: TF-IDF+LR 即可，检测器计算开销降低数量级"
    - "Unified continuous spectrum: b=0 uniform → b→∞ hard filter 的统一框架"
  relevance_to_us: "最直接的竞争者。共享 w=(1-q)^b 公式，但 b 选取方法根本不同——我们的核心贡献正是理论推导 adaptive b*"

- id: he_2025_golden_ratio
  title: "Golden Ratio Weighting Prevents Model Collapse"
  authors: "Hengzhi He, Shirong Xu, Guang Cheng"
  venue: "Under review at JRSSB, 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.18049"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18049"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "从理论推导合成/真实数据混合的最优权重，发现最优权重为黄金比例的倒数(~0.62)"
  key_findings: "在高斯估计、GLM、非参数估计等场景下，当合成数据与真实数据等量时，真实数据的最优权重约为 0.62（黄金比例倒数）。公式 w*=(√(k²+4k)−k)/2, k=真实/合成样本比"
  differentiation:
    scope: "纯理论工作，假设已知污染比例，未涉及检测器或 LLM 实验，不处理 unknown/online 设置"
  relevance_to_us: "同样是理论推导最优权重，但针对 real/synthetic 固定混合比例，未考虑检测器置信度的连续估计"

  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07515"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "使用 verifier 过滤合成数据防止 model collapse，理论证明即使不完美的 verifier 也有效"
  key_findings: "用高斯混合模型和线性分类器推导条件，证明 verifier 引导的合成数据筛选可避免 model collapse；即使 verifier 不完美也能受益"
  relevance_to_us: "与我们的方法最相似——都用检测器置信度来处理合成数据。区别在于他们做 hard filtering，我们做 soft reweighting"

- id: wang_2026_survive_contamination
  title: "Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Survive Data Contamination? Theoretical Guarantees under Contaminated Recursive Training"
  authors: "Kevin Wang, Hongqian Niu, Didong Li"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.16065"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16065"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  role: "τ（α_eff 质量下界阈值）的理论动机来源；在通用框架下证明污染递归训练仍然收敛"
  method_summary: >
    在最小假设（不限数据分布、允许通用逼近器生成模型）下研究递归训练。
    证明收敛率 = min(基线模型收敛率, α)，其中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是每轮真实数据比例。
    首个不依赖分布假设的递归训练正面理论结果。进一步扩展到采样偏差场景。
  key_findings: "收敛率由真实数据比例 α 下界控制；α 越大收敛越快；即使有污染，只要 α > 0 训练仍收敛"
  tension_with_our_work: >
    论文中 α = m₁/(m₁+m₂) 是**已知设计参数**（依赖已知的真实/合成数据比例），
    而我们的 τ 是 empirical hyperparameter（通过检测器统计量在线估计）。
    与 Claim 3（proportion-free）存在张力：Wang 的理论要求知道 α，
    我们的方法不假设已知比例，而是通过 α_eff(b) 间接逼近。
    需在论文中明确讨论：我们的 τ 是 α 的 principled proxy，而非精确值。
  relevance_to_us: "为 α_eff 阈值提供理论合理性——收敛保证依赖真实数据有效比例，我们的 b* 选取正是为了保证 α_eff(b) ≥ τ"

- id: subramanyam_2025_scaling_quality
  title: "Scaling Laws Revisited: Modeling the Role of Data Quality in Language Model Pretraining"
  authors: "Anirudh Subramanyam, Yuxin Chen, Robert L. Grossman"
  venue: "ICLR 2026"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2510.03313"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03313"
  openreview: "https://openreview.net/forum?id=x54wwB6QvL"
  category: theoretical-foundation
  verified: "2026-05-16 arXiv+OpenReview 双重验证"
  role: "用 ESS + 信息论动机建模数据质量参数 Q，提出 quality-aware scaling law"
  method_summary: >
    引入无量纲数据质量参数 Q，扩展 Chinchilla scaling law 为 loss = f(N, D, Q)。
    Q 的动机来自 effective-sample-size 和信息论视角。提供两种 Q 估计器：
    (i) corruption rate proxy, (ii) deficiency measure。
  key_findings: "数据质量可以被形式化为 scaling law 中的独立维度；ESS 视角为 Q 提供理论动机"
  differentiation:
    level: "Subramanyam: corpus-level 静态参数 Q（预测 loss） | 我们: per-batch 动态量 α_eff(b)（选 b*）"
    goal: "Subramanyam: scaling law 预测 | 我们: instance-level reweighting"
    detector: "Subramanyam: 不涉及检测器 | 我们: 检测器概率 q 驱动"
  relevance_to_us: "共享 ESS 理论动机。Related Work 中作为 ESS-based data quality formalization 引用，强调我们是 instance-level adaptive 而他们是 corpus-level static"

- id: amin_2025_escaping_collapse
  title: "Escaping Collapse: The Strength of Weak Data for Large Language Model Training"

  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15640"
  category: method-component
  role: "用 RL 学习 domain 级别数据混合权重，解决 continual pretraining 中的灾难性遗忘"
  key_findings: "首个 model-based end-to-end 域权重学习框架；RL agent 在大量 mixing trajectory 上学习泛化启发式；跨 source field、target model、domain space 泛化"
  relevance_to_us: "另一条 non-grid-search 路线（RL-based），但在 domain-level 操作且不处理污染检测；我们的 b* 推导更轻量（无需 RL 训练）"

- id: grangier_2025_crisp
  title: "Task-Adaptive Pretrained Language Models via Clustered-Importance Sampling"
  authors: "David Grangier, Simin Fan, Skyler Seto, Pierre Ablin"
  venue: "ICLR 2025"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2410.03735"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.03735"
  category: method-component
  verified: "2026-05-16 arXiv+Semantic Scholar 验证"
  role: "Clustered IS for pretraining distribution matching，同属 importance sampling 用于 pretraining"
  method_summary: >
    提出 CRISP（ClusteRed Importance SamPling）：聚类通用数据集，按专业数据中的频率进行重要性采样。
    可扩展，适用于 pretraining 和 continued pretraining，支持多任务设置。
  key_findings: "用聚类+重要性采样从通用大数据集构建专业模型；优于其他分布调整方法"
  relevance_to_us: "与 Drayson 的 SIR 和 Xie 的 DSIR 在方法论上相关——同属 importance sampling for pretraining。Related Work 中引用"

# ============================================================
# Category: background
# 数据污染/合成数据在 LLM 训练中的问题
# ============================================================

- id: shumailov_2024_model_collapse
  title: "AI Models Collapse When Trained on Recursively Generated Data"
  authors: "Ilia Shumailov, Zakhar Shumaylov, Yiren Zhao, Nicolas Papernot, Ross Anderson, Yarin Gal"
  venue: "Nature 2024"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07566-y"
  category: background
  role: "奠基性工作——证明在递归生成数据上训练导致 model collapse"
  key_findings: "在 LLM、VAE、GMM 上证明不加区分地用模型生成内容训练会导致不可逆退化；原始分布的尾部逐渐消失；反复训练的语言模型出现重复短语"
  relevance_to_us: "model collapse 是我们工作的核心动机——加权方案的目标就是防止污染数据导致的性能退化"

- id: alemohammad_2024_mad
  title: "Self-Consuming Generative Models Go MAD"
  authors: "Sina Alemohammad, Josue Casco-Rodriguez, Lorenzo Luzi, Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun, Hossein Babaei, Daniel LeJeune, Ali Siahkoohi, Richard G. Baraniuk"
  venue: "ICLR 2024"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.01850"
  category: background
  role: "提出 Model Autophagy Disorder (MAD) 概念——自消费式生成模型的退化"
  key_findings: "分析三种自消费循环（fully synthetic、synthetic augmentation、fresh data）；无新鲜真实数据时质量或多样性不可避免下降；即使保留原始训练数据也可能退化"
  relevance_to_us: "MAD 的数学框架帮助理解不同污染程度下的退化动力学，为我们的收敛理论提供上下文"

- id: dohmatob_2025_strong_collapse
  title: "Strong Model Collapse"
  authors: "Elvis Dohmatob, Yunzhen Feng, Arjun Subramonian, Julia Kempe"
  venue: "ICLR 2025 (Spotlight)"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2410.04840"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04840"
  category: background
  role: "证明即使极少量合成数据（1/1000）也能导致 model collapse"
  key_findings: "在 scaling laws 框架下建立 strong model collapse；用算子值自由概率论获得测试误差的 bias-variance 分解；更大模型可放大 collapse 效应"
  relevance_to_us: "强化了我们工作的必要性——即使少量合成污染也需要处理，仅靠增加数据量无法解决"

- id: nait_saada_2025_quality_illusion
  title: "The Data-Quality Illusion: Rethinking Classifier-Based Quality Filtering for LLM Pretraining"
  authors: "Thiziri Nait Saada, Louis Bethune, Michal Klein, David Grangier, Marco Cuturi, Pierre Ablin"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2025
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00866"
  category: background
  role: "质疑基于分类器的数据质量评分是否真正捕获了有意义的质量概念"
  key_findings: "CQF 改善下游任务但不一定改善语言建模；质量分类器隐式偏向其监督目标的数据分布；质量桶与特定 benchmark 对齐"
  relevance_to_us: "提醒我们检测器置信度 q 不等于真实质量——需要理论保证 b* 在检测器有偏时仍然有效"

- id: guo_2025_escaping_collapse
  title: "Escaping Model Collapse via Synthetic Data Verification"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2510.16657"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.16657"
  category: background
  role: "提出验证机制筛选合成数据质量，与 detection-based 方法互补"
  key_findings: "通过验证机制在合成数据生成后筛选质量，与基于检测器的事后加权方法互补"
  relevance_to_us: "verification-based 方法是另一条技术路线——他们做生成时验证，我们做训练时加权"

- id: cheng_2025_contamination_survey
  title: "A Survey on Data Contamination for Large Language Models"
  authors: "Yuxing Cheng, Yi Chang, Yuan Wu"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2502.14425"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14425"
  category: background
  role: "数据污染问题的全面综述，覆盖检测方法和 contamination-free 评估策略"
  key_findings: "系统整理训练/测试数据重叠的检测方法（MIA-based、reference-based、data updating/rewriting）；分析 contamination 对 benchmark 可靠性的影响；提出三类 contamination-free 评估策略"
  relevance_to_us: "为我们的 problem statement 提供全面综述支撑——pretraining data contamination 是 LLM 社区公认的系统性问题"

- id: wei_2024_data_watermarks
  title: "Proving Membership in LLM Pretraining Data via Data Watermarks"
  authors: "Johnny Tian-Zheng Wei, Ryan Yixiang Wang, Robin Jia"
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2402.10892"
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10892"
  category: background
  role: "用数据水印证明数据集是否在 LLM 预训练中被使用，数据溯源的主动方案"
  key_findings: "在公开发布前嵌入随机水印，检测建模为假设检验（控制误检率）；两种水印：随机序列插入和 Unicode lookalike 替换；水印强度随数据集增大而减弱但随模型增大而保持"
  relevance_to_us: "主动 provenance 方案（事前水印）vs 我们的被动方案（事后检测+加权）；互补但不冲突"

# ============================================================
# Category: evaluation
# 评估方法相关
# ============================================================

- id: mitchell_2023_detectgpt
  title: "DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature"
  authors: "Eric Mitchell, Yoonho Lee, Alexander Khazatsky, Christopher D. Manning, Chelsea Finn"
  venue: "ICML 2023"
  year: 2023
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.11305"
  category: evaluation
  role: "零样本机器生成文本检测方法——我们的检测器 q 的基线方法之一"
  key_findings: "LLM 生成的文本倾向于占据模型对数概率函数的负曲率区域；无需训练分类器、收集数据集或水印；在 GPT-NeoX 假新闻检测上从 0.81 AUROC 提升到 0.95"
  relevance_to_us: "可作为计算合成概率 q 的检测器之一；其概率曲率方法可能与我们的权重公式有理论联系"

- id: shi_2024_minkprob
  title: "Detecting Pretraining Data from Large Language Models"
  authors: "Weijia Shi, Anirudh Ajith, Mengzhou Xia, Yangsibo Huang, Daogao Liu, Terra Blevins, Danqi Chen, Luke Zettlemoyer"
  venue: "ICLR 2024"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.16789"
  category: evaluation
  role: "Min-K% Prob 方法——检测数据是否在预训练集中的无参考方法"
  key_findings: "已训练数据包含更少低概率异常 token；取最低 K% token 概率的平均值判断；在 WikiMIA 上比最佳基线高 7.4 AUC；无需参考模型"
  relevance_to_us: "Min-K% Prob 可作为估计合成概率 q 的候选方法；其 membership inference 思路可扩展为连续置信度估计"

- id: kuo_2024_data_weighting
  title: "Not All LLM-Generated Data Are Equal: Rethinking Data Weighting in Text Classification"
  authors: "Hsun-Yu Kuo et al."
  venue: "arXiv preprint"
  year: 2024
  url: "https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21526"
  category: evaluation
  role: "评估合成数据加权策略在文本分类中的效果"
  key_findings: "提出加权损失方法用少量真实数据对齐合成数据分布；在 BERT 级模型上稳定优于标准交叉熵和其他加权方法"
  relevance_to_us: "验证了合成数据需要差异化加权的思路；其评估框架可参考用于我们的下游任务评估"
